lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er3Al3Ir3 (ErAlIr) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 9 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Er and 6 Ir) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Er and Ir centers each have 15 neighbors (6 Al plus 9 Er or Ir). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 9 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Er and Ir 15-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Al 12-vertex and Er or Ir polyhedra.
